Ingredients

6 chicken eggs

4 cups water

3 tbsp Jasmine green tea leaves

¼ tbsp dark soy sauce

½ tsp minced ginger

½ tsp minced garlic

Procedure

Bring water and spices to a boil.

Add eggs, and boil for 3 minutes.

Remove eggs from the liquid and roll them gently on a hard surface to crack the shell all over.

Return the eggs to the pot of liquid, reduce to a simmer, and simmer for 1 hour.

Reduce to low heat and allow eggs to sit in brine until served.
